name: auth-flow-signup-wizard
title: Auth Flow Signup Wizard
description: A one-question-per-screen sign-up that slides each question in with a blur, advances on Enter and toggles choices with number keys. Beside it a member pass builds itself live from the answers, with a gradient avatar, workspace address, chosen uses and a stamp when the account is created.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
